subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should restart-drain bypass capability remain host-internal, or should OpenClaw intentionally expose it through the public plugin SDK?
rationale: The diff changes a public plugin contract and gateway-draining admission boundary; automation can identify the risk, but permanent SDK exposure needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Bypass Internal
options.body: Remove enqueueInternal from public SDK types/exports and keep restart-drain admission under host-owned internal plumbing.

options.title: Approve SDK Expansion
options.body: Document and test the new public plugin API, including compatibility and security expectations for third-party callers during gateway drain.

options.title: Pause For Broader Restart Recovery
options.body: Hold this branch until maintainers choose how it should relate to the broader durable restart message-loss work.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Internal
recommendation.body: Remove enqueueInternal from public SDK types/exports and keep restart-drain admission under host-owned internal plumbing.
